# opnsense_interfaces_gre (Resource)

GRE tunnels (Interfaces > Devices > GRE). Assign the device with `opnsense_interfaces_assignment` to route over it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_interfaces_gre" "branch" {
  local_address         = "wan"
  remote_address        = "203.0.113.20"
  tunnel_local_address  = "10.98.0.1"
  tunnel_remote_address = "10.98.0.2"
  tunnel_remote_net     = "30"
  description           = "GRE to branch office"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `local_address` (String) Local endpoint: an interface such as `wan`, or a virtual IP.
- `remote_address` (String) Remote endpoint address.
- `tunnel_local_address` (String) Local address inside the tunnel.
- `tunnel_remote_address` (String) Remote address inside the tunnel.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.
- `tunnel_remote_net` (String) Prefix length of the tunnel network. Defaults to `"32"`.

### Read-Only

- `device` (String) Device name assigned by OPNsense, e.g. `gre0`.
- `id` (String) UUID of the tunnel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_interfaces_gre.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
